grammarFocus: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do / does 问句。
title: Week 9 Listening: Learning Goals and Study Habits
instructions: 这是一份模拟听力练习材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读录音稿），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选题、填空题和判断题。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定字数。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. Do you have a study plan for this term?
Ben: Yes, I do. I usually study in the library after class. But this week I am studying at home because the library is closed.
Mia: Oh, really? Why is it closed?
Ben: They are painting the walls. So I am using my kitchen table. It is noisy, but I can focus.
Mia: Do you always study in the evening?
Ben: No, I don't. I often study in the afternoon. In the evening, I sometimes watch English videos. But I am not watching videos this week. I am preparing for a test.
Mia: A test? What test?
Ben: A math test. It is on Friday. I am a little nervous.
Mia: How often do you review your notes?
Ben: I review my notes every day. I usually review for thirty minutes. But this week I am reviewing for one hour because the test is difficult.
Mia: Do you study with friends?
Ben: Sometimes. My friend Leo is very good at math. He helps me. But he is busy this week. He is visiting his family.
Mia: So you are studying alone now?
Ben: Yes, I am. But I don't mind. I listen to quiet music. Do you study with music?
Mia: No, I don't. I need silence. I usually study in my bedroom. It is very quiet.
Ben: That sounds nice. Do you have a goal for this term?
Mia: Yes, I do. I want to improve my English. I am reading one short book every week. I also write a diary in English. I do it every night before bed.
Ben: That is a good habit. How often do you write?
Mia: I write every night. But I am not writing now. I am talking to you!
Ben: Ha ha, true. Well, good luck with your English goal.
Mia: Thanks. Good luck with your math test!

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does 问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常性的动作或习惯，常与频率副词（always, usually, often, sometimes, every day）连用。现在进行时表示现在正在进行的动作，结构是 be + 动词-ing。do/does 用于一般现在时的疑问句和否定句。
grammar.example: I usually study in the library after class. But this week I am studying at home because the library is closed.

options: She usually study in the evening.
She usually studies in the evening.
She usually studying in the evening.
answers: She usually studies in the evening.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语是第三人称单数 she 时，动词要加 -s，所以 studies 正确。
questions.evidence: She usually studies in the evening.

questions.explanation: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，疑问句用 Does，后面动词用原形 study。
现在进行时结构是 be + 动词-ing，主语 they 用 are，study 变 studying。

options: I don't watch TV in the morning.
I not watch TV in the morning.
I doesn't watch TV in the morning.
answers: I don't watch TV in the morning.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 的否定句用 don't + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: I don't watch TV in the morning.
